svg.text: Based on the KSV guide "Receiving positions and movements". Net at the top of every court, dashed line = 3 m line.
OP = diagonal (D) in the guide. R1 = setter in position 1 (H1), R2 = H6, R3 = H5, R4 = H4, R5 = H3, R6 = H2.
The two outside hitters and the libero
When starting in the back row, prepare
Who is in front/behind and beside me?
Am I on court, or is the libero in?
What is my job after the pass?
Back-row opposite attacks from behind the 3 m line.
KSV | Receiving positions and movements · “Our serve” = base defence (not in the guide). R3 and R6: the middle in zone 1 serves, because the libero may not serve (FIVB).
The serving team has no overlap rule (FIVB 7.4, since 2025): stand in your defence spot before the serve; only the server moves. Rows still count for blocking and attacking.
